Our DogsThat YouTube Channel is brought to you by Susan Garrett and her Team. Leading educators of owners of family pet dogs, dog sport competitors and dog trainers. Susan was one of the very first dog trainers to share knowledge online. Susan has helped hundreds of thousands of people enjoy a great relationship with their dogs through her workshops and keynote speaking around the world, award winning books, DVDs, magazine articles, blog posts, podcasts, free dog training and dog agility video series, and online dog training programs. 

Susan is world-renowned for her innovative game-based positive reinforcement training that is grounded in the science of animal behaviour. A life long learner, Susan has been at the cutting edge of online education development since 2008 with her popular classroom Recallers. We are planning even more sharing, education and fun here on our Dogs That YouTube page!
